Context:
[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Unpaid Parental Leave]
Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Unpaid Parental Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of one year of continuous service is abolished.

Leave Entitlement

- Team members are eligible for Unpaid Parental Leave from their first day of employment.
- Up to 18 weeks of unpaid leave per child, to look after their child's welfare.
- The entitlement is per child up to the age of 18, regardless of the person's employer.
- The balance of unpaid parental leave carries over to each employer. For example, if someone has taken 10 weeks of unpaid parental leave with their previous employer, they would be entitled to 8 weeks of leave with their new employer.
- Each parent can take up to 4 weeks each year per child, unless otherwise agreed with their employer.
- Leave must be taken in blocks of weeks rather than individual days.
- Team members must provide at least 21 days' notice.

How to Apply

Contact leaves@gitlab.com.

[Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave]
GitLab's Parental Leave is available for any active team member (regardless of gender) who becomes a parent through childbirth, adoption, fostering, or surrogacy (intended parent) while working at GitLab. This benefit is available from your first day of employment, provided your child was born, newly adopted, newly placed in your foster care, or born via surrogacy during your employment at GitLab.

GitLab provides 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave, which must be used prior to the child's first birthday, the first anniversary of the adoption, the first anniversary of the foster placement, or the first anniversary of the birth (for surrogacy). Team members are encouraged to decide for themselves how much time they'd like to take, but there are some parameters to keep in mind when planning your leave:

[Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave]
*GitLab’s paid Parental Leave is available for any active team member (regardless of gender) who becomes a parent through childbirth or adoption while working at GitLab. The information in this section is specific to GitLab’s 16-week paid Parental Leave. Different countries or US states may provide team members with their own statutory Parental Leave benefits. Please review your [country/state](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#entity-specific-benefits) Parental Leave benefits for more information on how to apply and tenure requirements (if applicable).*
